hypotheses.P1_base_jvp_reproduces_the_prior_failure: All-source base-JVP finite Fisher fidelity lies between 0.50 and 0.65.
hypotheses.P2_midpoint_substantially_improves_finit: Midpoint-JVP reconstruction exceeds base-JVP fidelity by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.P3_two_point_gauss_is_a_useful_finite_pr: Gauss-2 reconstruction has at least 0.85 aggregate Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.P4_four_point_gauss_nearly_reconstructs_: Gauss-4 reconstruction has at least 0.97 aggregate Fisher fidelity and 0.85 fifth-percentile individual fidelity.
hypotheses.P5_quadrature_error_converges: Aggregate reconstruction fidelity is nondecreasing from Gauss-2 through Gauss-4 to Gauss-8.
hypotheses.P6_gauss2_recovers_source_tensor_directi: Gauss-2 predicted versus exact source-delta tensor has median cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.P7_support_was_easier_than_amplitude: Gauss-4 improves all-source reconstruction over base JVP by at least 0.25, while improving exact-edge top-32 selection by at most 0.02.
hypotheses.P8_path_integral_transfers_across_layers: Gauss-4 reconstruction has at least 0.85 aggregate fidelity for every layer, corpus, and semantic family.
hypotheses.P9_local_support_is_stable_along_the_pat: Base- and endpoint-JVP top-16 source sets have median Jaccard overlap at least 0.60.
hypotheses.P10_four_points_are_close_to_eight: Gauss-8 improves aggregate reconstruction over Gauss-4 by at most 0.01.

hypotheses.J1_manual_differentiable_trace_matches_n: Manual base and changed source contributions have relative error at most 5e-5 against the established exact decomposition.
hypotheses.J2_jvp_source_delta_has_high_directional: The median cosine between JVP-predicted and exact per-example source-delta tensors is at least 0.80.
hypotheses.J3_jvp_ranking_selects_a_high_fidelity_p: Using exact finite deltas at JVP-ranked top-32 sources has mean Fisher fidelity at least 0.90 and fifth-percentile fidelity at least 0.75.
hypotheses.J4_jvp_selection_is_close_to_counterfact: JVP-ranked top-32 mean fidelity is within 0.05 of exact-delta-norm-ranked top-32.
hypotheses.J5_jvp_prediction_reconstructs_behavior_: Using the JVP-predicted deltas themselves at all 64 sources has mean Fisher fidelity at least 0.75.
hypotheses.J6_jvp_beats_static_base_shortcuts: At top-16, JVP ranking exceeds every base-only or positional control by at least 0.10 mean Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.J7_jvp_selection_transfers_across_layers: JVP top-32 has at least 0.75 aggregate fidelity for every layer, corpus, and semantic family.
hypotheses.J8_jvp_and_exact_programs_overlap: JVP and exact-state top-16 selections have median Jaccard overlap at least 0.40.
hypotheses.J9_input_similarity_alone_is_not_the_exp: JVP top-16 exceeds input-tangent-similarity top-16 by at least 0.15 mean fidelity.
hypotheses.J10_predictive_success_is_not_confined_t: The edited source alone has mean Fisher fidelity below 0.50 while JVP top-16 exceeds 0.80.
